projects.name: Anatomy-Aware DoseFlow
projects.description: A deep learning pipeline modeling CT dose distributions as a continuous flow, combining MedSAM segmentation with a ViT-Mamba backbone.
projects.problem: Reconstructing a full-dose CT scan from a low-dose acquisition without losing anatomical detail, across arbitrary dose levels (5%-100%), not just one fixed reduction ratio.
projects.solution: A three-stage pipeline that segments anatomy with MedSAM, then learns a dose-conditioned flow trajectory (ViT + Mamba encoders) between the low- and target-dose image manifolds.
projects.usp: Modeling dose reduction as a continuous flow field rather than a fixed input→output mapping lets one model generalize across dose levels and unseen anatomical regions.
projects.results: 48.15 dB PSNR and 0.9991 SSIM, with zero-shot generalization across three unseen anatomical regions.

projects.name: FLOW — Fraud & Loan Optimization Workbench
projects.description: A production-grade streaming platform for real-time fraud detection and loan targeting, built on an event-driven architecture.
projects.problem: Banking fraud detection and loan targeting both need model decisions on live transaction streams, but most pipelines are batch-oriented and too slow to act before a transaction settles.
projects.solution: An event-driven architecture on Pathway and NATS JetStream, streaming transactions through online-learning models (Hoeffding Trees, Online GMM) with Redis-backed low-latency caching.
projects.usp: Online learning models update continuously from live feedback instead of periodic retraining, so the system adapts to new fraud patterns as they emerge.
projects.results: Sub-5ms scoring latency and an 88% F1-score, with Prometheus/Grafana observability built in from day one.
projects.tools: Pathway, NATS JetStream, Redis, FastAPI, React

projects.name: LunaDEM
projects.description: A discrete element method simulator for lunar regolith, modeling grain-scale mechanics for rover-terrain interaction studies.
projects.problem: Predicting how a rover's wheels will interact with lunar regolith requires grain-scale physics simulation, which most terrain models skip in favor of coarse friction approximations.
projects.solution: A custom discrete element method (DEM) physics core simulating individual regolith grains, paired with a 3D visualizer for inspecting particle behavior under rover loads.
projects.usp: Simulating at the grain level (not a bulk-friction approximation) captures compaction and slippage effects that matter for real rover mobility planning.
projects.results: A working lightweight simulator with 3D visualization for inspecting particle-level terrain response.

projects.name: LokMitra AI
projects.description: A voice-first AI assistant for vernacular users, pairing Gemini-powered RAG with a Django/Next.js stack.
projects.problem: Most AI assistants assume text input and English fluency, locking out vernacular-speaking users who'd rather just ask a question out loud in their own language.
projects.solution: A voice-first assistant built on Django and Next.js, using Gemini-powered RAG to ground spoken questions in retrieved context and reply back entirely by voice.
projects.usp: The entire interaction loop stays voice-to-voice in the user's own language, removing the literacy and language barriers text-first assistants impose.
projects.results: A working end-to-end voice Q&A pipeline from spoken query to grounded, spoken answer.
projects.tools: Django, Next.js, Gemini API, RAG, PostgreSQL

projects.name: Smart-Scribes
projects.description: A multimodal lecture assistant that transcribes, summarizes, and answers questions over recorded lectures — won 1st overall at iHub.
projects.problem: Recorded lectures are hard to search or revise from — students want summaries and answers, not a two-hour video they have to scrub through.
projects.solution: A multimodal pipeline (video + audio + slides) using Whisper transcription and RAG to power lecture summarization and Q&A, wrapped in a Next.js dashboard.
projects.usp: Combining video, audio and slide content in one retrieval index gives more grounded answers than transcript-only lecture tools.
projects.results: 1st place overall among 1,600+ teams at the iHub Multimodal AI Hackathon, leading a 5-member team.

projects.name: AutoReach AI
projects.description: An agentic workflow system that plans and executes multi-step outreach tasks, built with LangGraph for tool use and retries.
projects.problem: Multi-step outreach workflows (research a lead, draft a message, follow up) usually need a human stitching tools together at every step.
projects.solution: An agentic system built on LangGraph that plans a task graph, calls tools autonomously, retries on failure, and hands off to a human only at defined checkpoints.
projects.usp: Explicit human-in-the-loop checkpoints keep the automation trustworthy for outreach, instead of a fully autonomous agent making irreversible calls.
projects.results: A working agent pipeline coordinating multi-step outreach tasks end-to-end with tool retries.

projects.name: Dual-System Voice Cloning & Anti-Spoofing
projects.description: A dual-system framework pairing neural voice cloning with real-time deepfake and anti-spoofing detection — won Hack 60's DL track.
projects.problem: Voice cloning tech is advancing fast, but the anti-spoofing systems meant to catch cloned/deepfake audio are usually built and evaluated separately from the cloning models they're meant to defend against.
projects.solution: A dual-system framework that pairs a neural voice cloning model with a real-time speaker-verification-based anti-spoofing detector, evaluated against each other directly.
projects.usp: Building and testing the attacker (cloning) and defender (anti-spoofing) systems together surfaces weaknesses that isolated evaluation would miss.
projects.results: Won the Deep Learning track at Hack 60 (HCLTech x IIT Mandi) with a real-time detection system.

projects.name: Vision Drive
projects.description: A perception stack for autonomous driving built on YOLO and OpenCV, handling real-time object and lane detection.
projects.problem: Autonomous driving perception needs to detect objects, lanes and obstacles in real time from a live video feed, with no room for frame-by-frame latency.
projects.solution: A YOLO-based perception stack combined with OpenCV lane-detection heuristics, processing live video feeds frame-by-frame for object and lane awareness.
projects.usp: Pairing a learned object detector with classical CV lane heuristics keeps the stack fast enough for real-time inference without sacrificing lane accuracy.
projects.results: A working real-time perception stack detecting objects and lane boundaries from live video.

projects.name: STAC IIT Mandi
projects.description: The public website for STAC (Space Technology and Astronomy Cell), IIT Mandi's astronomy and space-tech club, built while serving as the club's Technical Lead.
projects.problem: The club needed a central site to present its projects, events and members instead of scattering updates across social media.
projects.solution: A TypeScript front-end presenting STAC's activities and team, maintained as part of the technical-lead role overseeing the club's engineering initiatives.
projects.usp: Maintained directly by STAC's Technical Lead, keeping the site in sync with the club's actual ongoing projects rather than going stale.
projects.results: Serves as STAC's live public site for outreach and event promotion.

projects.name: IIT Mandi Finance Management Portal
projects.description: A role-based finance management portal for IIT Mandi's Finance Department, handling bill approvals, audits and procurement for the whole institute.
projects.problem: IIT Mandi's finance operations (bill approval, auditing, student purchases) ran through manual, paper-heavy workflows spread across departments, with no shared system for role-based approvals.
projects.solution: A Next.js 15 + Supabase + NextAuth.js portal with role-based access control for students, PDA managers, finance admins and auditors, covering bill application, editing, auditing and a finance-admin dashboard, with LDAP login and barcode generation.
projects.usp: Owned full SDLC as part of a 7-member team, replacing fragmented manual approval chains with a single role-aware system tied into the institute's existing LDAP identity system.
projects.results: Deployed in production for IIT Mandi's Finance Department, serving 50+ staff and processing over ₹10 lakh in transactions across billing, auditing and procurement workflows.
projects.tools: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, NextAuth.js, PostgreSQL, LDAP, Radix UI

projects.name: Striver A2Z DSA Sheet Solutions
projects.description: Topic-wise C++/Python solutions and notes for all 455 problems in the Striver A2Z DSA Sheet, organized across 18 categories.
projects.problem: Building consistent, interview-ready problem-solving skills across the full breadth of data structures and algorithms topics.
projects.solution: A structured repository of solutions, notes and difficulty-wise progress tracking spanning arrays, DP, graphs, tries and 14 other categories, following the well-known Striver A2Z curriculum.
projects.usp: This is a practice/reference repo, not a product — its value is the completeness and organization of the solution set rather than any novel system.
projects.results: 455 problems solved and documented across 18 topic areas, tracked start to finish.

projects.name: Travel Info Card
projects.description: A small React + TypeScript + Vite component for displaying travel information in a card layout.
projects.problem: Needed a lightweight, reusable UI component to present travel details cleanly, without pulling in a full application framework.
projects.solution: A minimal Vite-based React/TypeScript project scaffolding a travel info card component.
projects.usp: A deliberately small, focused utility rather than a full application — built for practicing component-level frontend patterns.
projects.results: A working, self-contained card component; kept intentionally scoped rather than expanded into a full app.

projects.name: Astrogenesis
projects.description: An AI research copilot that turns 608 NASA bioscience publications into an explorable, role-based knowledge base — winner of NASA Space Apps Chandigarh.
projects.problem: NASA's bioscience research corpus is too large and technical for scientists, investors or mission architects to quickly synthesize insights relevant to their role.
projects.solution: A Django + React platform using LangChain RAG over ChromaDB vector search and Google Gemini 2.0 Flash to ingest PDFs, tables and images from 608 publications, then answer natural-language queries with role-tailored summaries.
projects.usp: Role-based analysis (scientist vs. investor vs. mission architect) over the same underlying knowledge graph, rather than one-size-fits-all summarization.
projects.results: Won 1st place at NASA Space Apps Challenge (Chandigarh) as 'Astrogenesis', an LLM research copilot deployed live on Vercel.
projects.tools: Python, Django, React, LangChain, ChromaDB, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash

projects.name: Traffic DL Model Web
projects.description: A small web application serving a deep learning model for traffic analysis.
projects.problem: Making a trained traffic deep learning model usable through a web interface instead of only a training script.
projects.solution: A Python web app that loads the trained model and exposes it through a simple front-end for inference.
projects.usp: A compact, self-contained repo — kept minimal rather than padded out.
projects.results: A working web-served inference demo for the traffic model.

projects.name: Tumor Detection Website
projects.description: An AI web app that detects brain tumors from MRI scans using a custom-trained CNN, with a Flask backend and React frontend.
projects.problem: Manually reviewing MRI scans for tumor presence and location is slow and requires radiologist availability that isn't always immediate.
projects.solution: A custom CNN (convolution + pooling + fully connected layers) trained for tumor classification and localization, served through a Flask API and a React upload/preview interface that returns bounding boxes and probability scores.
projects.usp: End-to-end pipeline from raw MRI upload to a visual, probability-scored bounding-box result, not just a classification label.
projects.results: A working end-to-end demo: upload an MRI, get back a processed image with tumor bounding boxes and probability percentage.

projects.name: Legal Document Analyzer
projects.description: An AI-powered legal document analyzer built for the Google Gen AI Hackathon, extracting and grounding legal document analysis in Indian court documentation.
projects.problem: Legal documents (PDF/DOCX/XLS) are dense and full of amounts, dates and clauses that are hard to verify or price-check manually.
projects.solution: A Next.js 15 + FastAPI app that extracts text via Google Cloud Vision OCR, analyzes amounts/dates/purposes, cross-checks real-time pricing, and grounds findings with RAG over Indian court documents using LangChain/LangGraph and Supabase pgvector.
projects.usp: Combines document extraction with live pricing comparison and legal-reference RAG in one pipeline, rather than just summarizing the document in isolation.
projects.results: Built as a 5-person team (Naman, Prabhnoor, Japneet, Dhanad, Kartavya) for the Google Gen AI Hackathon, with a working extraction-to-summary pipeline.
projects.tools: Next.js, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Supabase pgvector, Google Cloud Vision, Gemini

projects.name: Dynamic QR Redirect
projects.description: A lightweight tool for generating QR codes whose destination URL can be changed after the code is printed.
projects.problem: A static QR code is stuck pointing at whatever URL it was generated with — if the destination changes, every printed copy of the code becomes dead.
projects.solution: A redirect layer: the QR code encodes a stable link to this service, which looks up and forwards to the current destination URL, so the target can be updated without reprinting the code.
projects.usp: Solves one specific, real annoyance with static QR codes rather than being a general-purpose QR-code generator.
projects.results: A working redirect service; a small, focused utility rather than a large product.

projects.name: STAC Capture the Flag Platform
projects.description: A Capture The Flag competition platform for STAC IIT Mandi, with an admin console, live scoreboard and automated flag verification.
projects.problem: Running a CTF for a student club needs secure challenge management, real-time scoring and abuse-resistant flag submission — building this from scratch is a lot of infrastructure for a single event.
projects.solution: A CTF platform (built on the CTFd framework) configured with secure admin control, a real-time scoreboard, a points system with negative marking, automated answer verification, and support for audio/PDF/DOC/image challenge uploads.
projects.usp: Tailored specifically for STAC IIT Mandi's competition format — negative marking and multi-format challenge uploads beyond a stock CTF deployment.
projects.results: Used as the CTF platform for STAC IIT Mandi's competitions, with live scoreboards and automated verification in production.

projects.name: Plant Health Optimiser
projects.description: A system for monitoring and diagnosing plant health using environmental sensors combined with AI-driven image analysis.
projects.problem: Gardeners and farmers often can't tell a plant is stressed until visible damage has already set in, and manual monitoring doesn't scale.
projects.solution: A React front-end paired with environmental sensor data and AI-driven image analysis to give real-time diagnostics and actionable care recommendations.
projects.usp: Combines sensor telemetry with image-based diagnosis rather than relying on either signal alone.
projects.results: A working monitoring system aimed at gardeners, farmers and plant enthusiasts for maintaining optimal growing conditions.

projects.name: Club & Society Platform
projects.description: A collaborative platform for college clubs and societies to manage member profiles, research discussions, events and shared resources.
projects.problem: College clubs and societies often lack a shared platform to showcase projects, coordinate events and connect members, relying instead on scattered spreadsheets and group chats.
projects.solution: A React web app providing member profiles, research discussion threads, event updates and resource sharing in one collaborative space.
projects.usp: Designed to be reusable by any club or society, not tied to one specific group's structure.
projects.results: A working collaborative platform for club/society management and member engagement.

projects.name: Food Order & Delivery App
projects.description: A full-stack MERN food ordering and delivery app with authentication, cart management and admin controls.
projects.problem: Small food vendors need an ordering and delivery workflow (browse, cart, checkout, order tracking) without building it from scratch each time.
projects.solution: A MongoDB/Express/React/Node.js app covering user authentication, cart management, order history and an admin control panel, backed by MongoDB Atlas.
projects.usp: A complete MERN reference implementation covering the full order lifecycle, not just a menu-browsing demo.
projects.results: A working full-stack food ordering and delivery app with authentication and admin controls.

projects.name: Anusandhan IIT Mandi
projects.description: A web platform built for Anusandhan, IIT Mandi's research and innovation initiative.
projects.problem: Anusandhan needed a web presence to represent its research and innovation activities to the student community.
projects.solution: A TypeScript web app presenting the initiative's activities and information.
projects.usp: Purpose-built for a specific institute initiative rather than a generic template.
projects.results: A live site representing Anusandhan's activities at IIT Mandi.

projects.name: Portfolio Backend
projects.description: A standalone Python backend service, built as a companion API layer for the author's portfolio work.
projects.problem: Providing a lightweight backend/API layer separate from the frontend portfolio site.
projects.solution: A small Python service exposing backend endpoints; kept as its own repository rather than bundling backend logic into the frontend app.
projects.usp: Kept intentionally minimal and separate from the frontend it supports.
projects.results: A working but sparsely documented backend utility.

projects.name: Academic Scheduler & Attendance Tracker (ASAT)
projects.description: A Next.js app for scheduling academic activities and tracking attendance.
projects.problem: Coordinating class schedules and attendance records manually is error-prone and hard to keep in sync across a term.
projects.solution: A Next.js/TypeScript web app for building academic schedules and tracking attendance records in one place.
projects.usp: Combines scheduling and attendance tracking in a single lightweight tool rather than two separate systems.
projects.results: A working scheduler/attendance-tracking app, built as a scaffolded Next.js project.

projects.name: SIH-180
projects.description: A project built for Smart India Hackathon (problem statement SIH-180).
projects.problem: Addressing the specific problem statement assigned under Smart India Hackathon's SIH-180 track.
projects.solution: A TypeScript web application built during the hackathon to address the given problem statement.
projects.usp: Built under hackathon time constraints as a team submission to a national competition.
projects.results: Submitted as a working prototype for Smart India Hackathon; repository documentation is minimal.

projects.name: Deepfake-Proof eKYC
projects.description: A real-time identity verification system combining deepfake detection and liveness authentication, built for the Deepfake-Proof eKYC Challenge (ZenTej Season 3, CAIR IIT Mandi).
projects.problem: eKYC systems that only match a selfie to an ID photo are vulnerable to deepfakes and replayed video — they need to also verify the person is live and the media isn't forged.
projects.solution: A pipeline combining a Siamese CNN for ID-to-selfie matching, a frequency-domain CNN for deepfake/forgery detection, and temporal motion-based liveness detection, with Grad-CAM explainability and a Flask/FastAPI service deployable as a lightweight TFLite/ONNX microservice.
projects.usp: Layers identity matching, forgery detection and liveness checking together with explainability (Grad-CAM), rather than treating eKYC as a single-model face-match problem.
projects.results: A working real-time verification pipeline built for the ZenTej Season 3 challenge at CAIR IIT Mandi.
projects.tools: PyTorch, OpenCV, DeepFace, facenet-pytorch, ONNX Runtime, Flask/FastAPI, Streamlit

projects.name: SIH165 — Chat Interface Website
projects.description: A website with an integrated chat interface, built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH165), designed in Figma and implemented in React.
projects.problem: Addressing the SIH165 problem statement, which called for a web platform with a built-in chat interface.
projects.solution: A React/TypeScript site implementing a Figma-designed chat interface as the core interaction pattern.
projects.usp: Design-to-code handoff from a dedicated Figma spec, built during the hackathon.
projects.results: Submitted as a working hackathon prototype; repository documentation is minimal.

projects.name: RoboCar Control Website
projects.description: A web-based control interface for a robotics car project, written primarily in C++.
projects.problem: Controlling a robot car needs a real-time interface layer bridging the web frontend and the vehicle's embedded control logic.
projects.solution: A C++-based control system exposing a website interface for operating the robot car.
projects.usp: Puts real-time vehicle control behind a web interface rather than a dedicated hardware controller.
projects.results: A working control setup for the robot car; repository documentation beyond the source is minimal.
